# Flow Cytometry Standard (FCS)
The FCS file contains both the raw data and the specifications necessary to completely describe it. 

Originally deviced back 1984 (FCS 1.0), the current standard is FCS3.1 (`flod::read_fcs` supports 3.0 and above).
